purpose: Evidence-backed input for an independently implemented structural math editor. This is not a claim of behavioral parity.
interpretation_rules: An absent property is unknown, never false, zero, an empty array, or a product default.
Assignments are ordered. Multiple assignments to one property preserve source order; no runtime final object is claimed.
Static initialization, dispatch facts, documentation facts, analyst formulas, and proposed probes have different evidence kinds.
Method and field tokens are valid only with the artifact digest and MVID recorded here.
Descriptors are initialization facts only. Imported values must not be treated as complete parser or editor implementation.
Do not infer execution from a static call edge.

coverage.excluded_reason: Internal engine emission templates are outside this editor contract.
